sourceCopy.title: Customer Lifetime Value Calculator Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Estimate customer lifetime value from monthly revenue, gross margin and churn. Add CAC for payback and LTV:CAC. Free and private in your browser.
sourceCopy.intro: Estimate a simple customer lifetime value (LTV) from monthly revenue per customer, gross margin and monthly churn. Optionally add customer acquisition cost (CAC) to compare payback and LTV:CAC.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How do you calculate customer lifetime value from churn?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: This simple method estimates LTV as monthly revenue per customer × gross margin ÷ monthly customer churn. With monthly revenue 100, 50% margin and 5% monthly churn, LTV is 1,000 before CAC and overhead.
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. The calculation runs locally in this browser. Your revenue, margin, churn and CAC values are not uploaded or saved by this tool.
howTo: Enter monthly revenue per customer, gross margin percentage and monthly customer churn percentage.
Optionally enter customer acquisition cost (CAC) and a three-letter currency code for display.
Calculate and review estimated LTV, expected lifetime, gross profit per month, CAC payback and LTV:CAC when CAC is above zero.

additionalFaqs.question: How does monthly churn estimate customer lifetime?
additionalFaqs.answer: Under a simple constant-churn assumption, expected lifetime in months is 100 divided by the monthly churn percentage. At 5% churn, that is 20 months. Real retention can change over time.

additionalFaqs.question: Does LTV include customer acquisition cost or overhead?
additionalFaqs.answer: LTV here is based on revenue and gross margin. CAC is shown separately as a ratio and simple payback comparison; overhead, taxes, discounting and changing cohorts are excluded.
